symptom: ako/mxcli#981 items 1-3: view-entity OQL passed check and failed mxbuild CE0174 — `r.Season = r.CurrentSeason as IsCurrent` ("The '=' part is incomplete or incorrect. You could use here: FROM."), `count(r.Season)` next to `group by r.Season` (also `max(r.D)` by `datepart(YEAR, r.D)`, `sum(r.S)` by `r.S + 1`), and a plain column that is not grouped (`r.Name` next to `group by datepart(...)`, `group by r.Season` or `group by r.ID`)
cause: ValidateOQLSyntax had no select-expression or GROUP BY rules at all
insight: Measure the controls along with the failures — they decide the predicate: the comparison inside CASE builds; count of a NON-grouped column builds; `group by <select alias>` builds; a function of a grouped expression (`datepart(...) + 1`) builds; and grouping by r.ID does NOT exempt r.Name (no functional dependency in mxbuild). Compare expressions after normalising case/whitespace/identifier quotes, substituting GROUP BY expressions longest-first; skip UNION queries, whose branches carry their own lists
